changes: Takes 512 bytes less of the shared mod area (8,716 bytes, was 9,228): stock's hold compare is kept from ending a hold by two byte sites (0x40109bc2, 0x40109bce) that compare its counter with 0x7fffffff, in place of a ptr site to a 512-byte table of that value. The same flags for every counter and HLD value; the rest of .run byte-identical. No change in behaviour.
stockPolicy: No firmware or stock-derived code/tables are present. Addresses, lengths and SHA-256 guards are metadata; exported instructions and sections are authored module code. Local materialized recipes and firmware are never committed.
